deadline_rules.label: File inventory and appraisal
deadline_rules.verify_note: Confirm interval and whether Loc. R. shortens or conditions it.

deadline_rules.label: Hearing on inventory set after filing
deadline_rules.verify_note: Confirm; hearing may be waived. Check waiver practice in Franklin.

deadline_rules.label: Claims against estate barred
deadline_rules.verify_note: CRITICAL. This runs from date of death, not appointment, and is not extendable. Confirm the interval and the presentment mechanics before any calculated date is shown to a user.

deadline_rules.label: Notice to administrator of Medicaid Estate Recovery Program
deadline_rules.verify_note: Confirm interval, trigger, and which estates are exempt.

deadline_rules.label: Surviving spouse election to take against will
deadline_rules.verify_note: Confirm the trigger. Election timing keys off service of the citation and/or initial appointment; getting the anchor wrong here is severe.

deadline_rules.label: Notice of probate of will to interested parties
deadline_rules.verify_note: Confirm both the service interval and the separate certificate-of-service deadline.

deadline_rules.label: Estate fully administered / account due
deadline_rules.verify_note: LEAST CERTAIN RULE IN THIS FILE. The six-month figure, whether it is a completion deadline or an accounting deadline, and the interaction with the thirty-day post-completion final account all need direct confirmation. Do not ship until read from the current statute and Sup. R. 78.

deadline_rules.label: Real Estate Only filing not permitted until 6 months after death
deadline_rules.citation: Franklin County Probate Court, Small Estate Forms page
deadline_rules.verify_note: This one is stated on the court's own forms page ('May not be Filed Until 6 Months After Date of Death'), so it is better sourced than most here -- but confirm the underlying authority rather than citing a web page.
